svg.title: Modular Monolith
svg.desc: Modular Monolith. One deployable unit built from strongly bounded modules that talk through explicit interfaces. Step 1, One unit, clear modules: One application, built and deployed as a unit. Orders calls Catalog's API in-process: no network. Step 2, Boundaries are enforced: Shortcuts into Catalog's internals and tables fail the build; the call through its API passes. Step 3, Interfaces and events: Orders asks Catalog through its API, then announces OrderPlaced: Shipping and Payments react. Step 4, Extract only for a reason: Payments must scale alone, so it moves out: a network API and its own database. The rest stay.

g.text: One application, built and deployed as a unit. Orders calls Catalog's API in-process: no network.
Shortcuts into Catalog's internals and tables fail the build; the call through its API passes.
Orders asks Catalog through its API, then announces OrderPlaced: Shipping and Payments react.
Payments must scale alone, so it moves out: a network API and its own database. The rest stay.
built, deployed and run as one unit

text.tspan: one build · one release · one process

g.text: a plain in-process call: no network, no serialisation
shortcuts: a call into Catalog's internals, a join on Catalog's tables
call: ask, wait for the answer
one database: a separate schema per module
